title: Daniel's busy week
instructions: Daniel günlük rutinini ve hafta sonu planlarını anlatıyor. Metinde "usually / but / don't" gibi çeldiriciler var; dikkatli dinle. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: Hi, I'm Daniel. I'm a nurse at a big hospital, and my days are very busy.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: I usually get up at six o'clock, but on Saturdays I get up at nine.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: I have breakfast at half past six.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: I don't drink coffee in the morning. I drink tea.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: I go to work by bus. I don't drive, because I don't have a car.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: I start work at eight o'clock and I finish at four.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: After work, I go to the gym on Mondays and Wednesdays.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: On Tuesdays and Thursdays, I have Spanish lessons.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: Next weekend, I have a lot of plans.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: On Saturday morning, I'm going to visit my grandmother. She lives in a small town near the sea.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: On Saturday evening, I want to go to the cinema with my friend Paula.

script.speaker: daniel
script.text: But on Sunday, I'm going to stay at home and sleep!

questions.prompt: What time does Daniel get up on Saturdays?
questions.feedback: Daniel genelde (usually) altıda kalkıyor, ama (but) cumartesileri dokuzda. "Half past six" kahvaltı saati.
questions.evidence: but on Saturdays I get up at nine.

questions.prompt: What does Daniel drink in the morning?
questions.feedback: Önce "coffee" kelimesini duyuyorsun ama olumsuz cümlede (don't drink). Sabahları çay içiyor.
questions.evidence: I don't drink coffee in the morning. I drink tea.

questions.prompt: How does Daniel go to work?
questions.feedback: İşe otobüsle gidiyor. Arabası yok, bu yüzden "by car" yanlış.
questions.evidence: I go to work by bus.

questions.prompt: What does Daniel do on Tuesdays?
questions.feedback: Spor salonu pazartesi ve çarşamba. Salı ve perşembe İspanyolca dersi var.
questions.evidence: On Tuesdays and Thursdays, I have Spanish lessons.

questions.prompt: What is Daniel going to do on Sunday?
questions.feedback: Büyükanne ziyareti ve sinema cumartesi. Pazar günü evde kalıp uyuyacak.
questions.evidence: But on Sunday, I'm going to stay at home and sleep!
